title: Croatian Sausage Skillet Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Indian-inspired curry made with croatian sausages, onions, and bell peppers, cooked in a thick skillet.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of skillet oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the chopped bell pepper and sauté for another 2 minutes.
Add the croatian sausages and cook until browned.
Add the curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add 1/2 cup of water and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
Garnish with chopped cilantro if desired.
